5
Which statement about the mass of an object is correct?
A
It changes when the object is lifted further from the ground.
B
It is the gravitational force on the object.
C
It is zero if the object is in orbit around the Earth.
D
It resists any change in motion of the object.

options.label: A
options.text: It changes when the object is lifted further from the ground.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the gravitational force on the object.

options.label: C
options.text: It is zero if the object is in orbit around the Earth.

options.label: D
options.text: It resists any change in motion of the object.
